facts.text: John thanked Maria for her previous message and expressed his intention to spend time with his family.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Maria! I'm off to spend some time with them now.

facts.text: John and Maria exchanged friendly goodbyes, with John expressing hope for Maria's safety.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Maria! You too! Stay safe!

facts.text: John mentioned that he and his family enjoy outdoor activities such as hiking, picnics, and board games, as well as movie nights at home.

evidence.quote: We love being outdoors - going for hikes, hanging out at the park, having picnics - plus playing board games and having movie nights at home.
